hyperedges.description: Full ComfyUI inpainting workflow: an SDXL-family checkpoint (hayochamixIDXL_v11) supplies MODEL/CLIP/VAE; the custom 'Mask Editor One' node (comfyui-mask-editor-one) loads a source image and lets the user paint/edit a mask (with invert and blur_radius options), outputting image + mask; these feed VAE Encode (for Inpainting) along with two CLIP Text Encode prompt nodes (positive/negative); KSampler denoises the inpaint latent (ddim sampler, simple scheduler, 30 steps, cfg 4.0, denoise 1.0); VAE Decode converts the result back to pixel space; Save Image writes the final output.
